purpose: Fixed-text-budget multimodal zero-shot baseline: Aurora (aurora-model==0.2.0) on TimesX native per-window text (method tag M48T512), compared against the frozen EXP-010 A48 unimodal baseline under the identical EXP-004 evaluation protocol (same windows, denominators, seeds).
scope_statement: M48T512 measures ONLY the gain of the current fixed-input text scheme over EXP-010; it does NOT represent Aurora's capability under full (untruncated) text. Event publication timing is NOT independently audited.
declaration: Aurora is NOT trained or fine-tuned on TimesX. Pre-training data overlap is not audited, so no stronger claim is made.
no_search: No model modification and no hyperparameter search: budgets, block order, tokenizer and all inference settings are frozen a priori.

data.exp010_reference: A48 frozen baseline (main branch commit 7479ee5), itl=48 unimodal zero-shot; overall std-MSE 4.293598+/-0.001592 (display precision)
data.window: past = series[s:s+96], target = series[s+96:s+108], s = variables[var_key].sample_start_idx[sample_id], test list = variables[var_key].native.test
data.window_key: (var_key, sample_id) composite key; uniqueness, text-cache lookup and all alignment checks use the composite key only — never row position

model.loading: identical to EXP-010 load_aurora.py: sha256 verify -> state_dict key bidirectional diff vs safetensors -> load_state_dict(strict=True) -> eval() -> all params requires_grad_(False)

inference.itl_note: itl=48 identical to the frozen EXP-010 A48 baseline. The EXP-010 itl=9 candidate remains unrun and is OUT OF SCOPE for this round.
inference.pred_reduction: mean over the 100-sample dim -> single point forecast (float64)
inference.text_tensor_path: text_input_ids / text_attention_mask / text_token_type_ids passed as explicit Long tensors [1,512] moved to model.device; token_type_ids all zeros; the string path text_inputs= is FORBIDDEN (known batch-squeeze and device defects).

text.source: TimesX_Datasets.zip native per-sample fields: background, scenario (Events), holiday_info (Calendar), covariates_info (Covariates). Text enters inference ONLY through the frozen cache built by repro_mm_timesx_v1/text_cache.py from these fields; the builder's constructor receives the four field strings only, never the sample dict.
assembly_rules: whitespace-normalize each field; skip a block if empty or the literal 'Unknown' (618 daily test windows skip Calendar)
per block, tokenize '<Name>: <field>' with the in-package bert_config BertTokenizer, add_special_tokens=False, keep the FIRST <budget> tokens
budgets INCLUDE the block-name tokens: Background 48, Events 270, Calendar 64, Covariates 128 (sum 510); NO budget transfer between blocks
fixed order Background -> Events -> Calendar -> Covariates; [CLS] + content + [SEP]; right-pad to 512 (pad id 0, attention mask 0)

tokenizer.kind: BertTokenizer (slow) shipped in the aurora package: aurora/bert_config/, local_files_only=True, do_lower_case=true, model_max_length=512

cache.schema: ids int32 [2474,512], mask int32 [2474,512], explicit key arrays var_keys/sample_ids/domains; meta line per window: per-block raw/kept token counts, [start,end) boundaries in the 512 sequence, full decoded text + its sha256, zip provenance
cache.id_verification: expected token IDs are re-derived by the fixed rules (normalize -> '<Name>: <field>' -> encode(add_special_tokens=False) -> first N) and compared for EXACT equality against cache rows; decoded text is for human inspection only and is NOT required to equal the original field verbatim (BERT lowercases and splits punctuation/subwords).

text.retention_note: TextEncoder.max_length=125: BERT first contextualizes ALL valid input positions via full self-attention, then the first 125 contextualized features are retained and distilled by 10 learnable queries (cross_text). The retained rows correspond to input content positions 1..125 (index 0 is [CLS]; CLS and SEP rows are zeroed by the valid mask before retention). Rear text (indices >= 126, Calendar/Covariates region) can therefore still influence output through attention even though its own features are not retained. This mechanism is NOT modified; the preflight quantifies rear-token sensitivity by fixing input indices 0..125 ([CLS] + the content positions feeding the retained features) AND the whole attention mask, then replacing only rear valid tokens from index 126 (equal length). Pad-position BERT features entering the retained window when content <125 tokens are inherent model behavior, recorded not fixed.

seeds.application: torch.manual_seed(w) immediately before each window's generate() call; no other RNG consumption between seeding and generate(); rule and prefix IDENTICAL to EXP-010 so seeds pair with A48 windows

determinism.timing: CUBLAS_WORKSPACE_CONFIG=':4096:8' must be set in process env BEFORE any CUDA initialization; torch.use_deterministic_algorithms(True), torch.backends.cuda.matmul.allow_tf32=False, torch.backends.cudnn.allow_tf32=False, torch.backends.cudnn.benchmark=False must all be applied BEFORE the first inference call.
determinism.error_policy: If a determinism error names a specific op, record the op and the disposition in the preflight report; never silently fall back to warn_only. The text branch (BERT/TextGuider/cross_text) may introduce new ops; same policy applies.

scoring.window_d: d = pstdev(past96, ddof=0); if d < 1e-8: d = fallback_std (precomputed in split_manifest per variable from first training sample past-96)
scoring.std_mse: mean(((pred - target)/d)^2) per window -> mean per variable -> equal weight within domain -> equal weight across 19 domains
scoring.std_mae: mean(|pred - target|/d) with the same aggregation ladder
scoring.d_vs_revin_note: The scoring denominator d (pstdev with fallback) and Aurora's internal RevIN scale (std(unbiased=False)+1e-5) are distinct quantities. Scoring uses only d; inference uses only the official revin path. They are never interchanged or blended.
scoring.paired_delta_ladder: Window-level paired differences (M48T512 - A48, same seed, same composite key) -> mean per variable -> equal weight within domain -> equal weight across 19 domains -> overall. NEVER a plain average over all windows. Relative changes and improved domain/variable counts reported alongside.

per_shard_header: code_md5 (root key sources + repro_mm_timesx_v1 key sources)
shard_fingerprint.resume_policy: On resume, every header field is re-verified against the current protocol; ANY mismatch (including a one-byte change to the text cache or any builder/code file) -> shard is NOT reused, moved to repro_mm_timesx_v1/predictions/quarantine/ (never deleted), and re-generated.
shard_fingerprint.done_marker: .done JSON with the same fingerprint is written only after atomic shard completion

outputs.npz_schema: sample_ids(int64)/var_keys(str)/domains(str)/pred(N,12 float64)/target(N,12 float64)/d(N, float64), sharded by (base_seed, domain), Z0/A48-compatible, under repro_mm_timesx_v1/predictions/ with method tag M48T512
outputs.aggregate: repro_mm_timesx_v1/results/: per-seed, variable-level, 19-domain and overall (mean +/- std ddof=1) for M48T512; A48 recomputed at full precision from the frozen root predictions/ shards (not from display CSVs); Z0 from data/Z0__test.npz; paired-difference tables per the frozen ladder
outputs.coverage_check: per seed: key set equal to Z0__test.npz keys (2,474 rows); target and d recomputed from frozen data and compared bitwise; predictions finite

eval_gate.approval_flag: --i-approve-frozen-protocol <first 12 hex of sha256(protocol_mm.json)>; the EXP-010 token (580eb3c3f51d) MUST be rejected by this driver
eval_gate.runtime_checks: all sha256 fingerprints re-verified at startup; text cache npz sha + key set equality with the 2,474 frozen test rows; GPU >= 20 GB free; test window count == 2474
eval_gate.status: implemented but NOT started in this round; official run is pre-authorized ONLY after all preflight sections pass on the frozen configuration
